labels.Empty means no target: Leave all three inputs empty for no target.

tooltips.targetTimeSeconds: Calendar time allowed for each visit. Changes apply to future entries only. Won/Lost stages are not timed. Leave empty for no target.
tooltips.order: Display order in dropdowns (lower numbers appear first)
tooltips.probability: Expected probability of closing at this stage (0-100%)
tooltips.style: Visual style/color for this stage in the UI

messages.Invalid target time: Enter at least one minute using non-negative whole numbers, or clear all inputs. Maximum: 24,855 days.
